behavior: A Number Field submits the number that it shows. Text with two dots or more is a number only when each dot before the last one can be a group separator, as in `1.234.567.89`. A run of dots counts as one dot, as in Base UI: `1..5` and `1,,5` in `de-DE` are 1.5. Other text, such as `1.2.3`, does not change the value. The rule also applies to the decimal separator of the locale: `1,2,3` in `de-DE` does not change the value. Base UI reads `1.2.3` as 12.3, so the field shows `1.2.3` and submits 12.3.
